title: coord's key directory nests groups as deep as GitLab's, and a group's keys are written by its own operators and those of the groups above it
goal: coord.py serve reads a key file at any depth of --keys: DIR/G1/.../OPERATOR is the operator G1/.../OPERATOR, whose groups are G1, G1/G2 and so on; a claim or put of a key under group/G1/.../GN/ is accepted from an operator whose group path is that path or one of its ancestors and exits 1 for any other caller; a key under team/NAME/ keeps its rule, NAME read as a group one level deep; flat operators and keys outside group/ and team/ behave as before; every event a served caller leaves names the full operator path

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
kd=os.path.join(d,"keys")
def key(p,t):
    f=os.path.join(kd,*p.split("/")); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f),exist_ok=True); open(f,"w").write(t); os.chmod(f,0o600); return f
a=key("corp/ops/jan.kowalski","ka-placeholder"); b=key("corp/dev/anna.nowak","kb-placeholder"); c=key("corp/ops/edge/piotr.nowak","kc-placeholder"); t=key("ops/ewa.nowak","kd-placeholder")
EXTRA=[]
sv=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--store",os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"),"serve","--bind","127.0.0.1:0","--keys",kd]+EXTRA,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
url=sv.stdout.readline().split("serving")[1].strip()
put=lambda k,kk: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--url",url,"--key-file",k,"put",kk,"--value","{}","--revision","0"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60).returncode
r=[put(a,"group/corp/ops/x"),put(a,"group/corp/ops/edge/y"),put(c,"group/corp/ops/z"),put(b,"group/corp/ops/w"),put(t,"team/ops/v"),put(b,"team/ops/u")]
sv.terminate(); assert r==[0,0,1,1,0,1], r
